name: expence-tracker
description: Expense tracker monorepo (Next.js web + NestJS API + Prisma/PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @expence-tracker/shared" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @expence-tracker/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
